source_editions.edition: 2018 accepted institutional manuscript, one publisher cover plus 20 authored pages

source_reuse: Prior complete primary readings are reused for all unchanged statements. This is a full review of the new mathematical transfers, not a claim to have reread every original PDF again. N001 is the authored browser representation; original PDF remains unavailable.

rows.target: For every inductively minimal finite pair (Gamma,G), the pair is RWPRI and has properties (2T)_1 and (IP)_2.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: For an inductively minimal pair, failure of PRI implies QPRI; failure of PRI occurs exactly when the connected diagram has a middle (a nonend whose deletion components have equal cardinality).
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: An inductively minimal pair is RPRI if and only if its diagram is a complete graph.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: For a normal subgroup N of G, mu(G) <= mu(G/N)+mu_prime(N). If N is abelian, mu(G) <= mu(G/N)+mu_prime_G(N), with G acting on N by conjugation. The printed source says a group; this contract takes finite G.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: For n >= 7, every independent generating set S of S_n of size n-1 is S(T), the edge transpositions of a labelled tree T, or {s} union {(s t)^epsilon(t): t in S(T) except s}, where s in S(T) and epsilon(t) in {+1,-1}. Conversely every set of either form is an independent generating set of S_n.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: For the two families of Theorem 2.1, the numbers of actual unordered generating sets are n^(n-2) and (n-1)n^(n-2), respectively; identifying each 3-cycle with its inverse changes the second count to binomial(n,2)(n-1)^(n-3). Degree n >= 7 is inherited from that theorem.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: For n >= 7 every independent generating set (s_i:i in I) of S_n of size n-1 is strongly independent: with G_J=<s_i:i not in J>, G_J intersect G_K = G_(J union K) for all J,K subsets of I.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: For n >= 7 and B <= S_n, mu(S_n,B)=n-1 implies B=1.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.source_reference: Theorem 3.1 and its immediately stated consequence
rows.target: A source coset geometry for G with Borel B has rank <= mu_prime(G,B). An RWPRI source coset geometry has rank <= mu(G,B), and choices s_i in H_(I minus {i}) outside H_i form a strongly independent relative generating family. The printed source does not impose finite G; this contract takes finite G.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: For n >= 7 there is a bijection between independent generating sets of S_n of size n-1, modulo simultaneous conjugation and inversion of individual generators, and RWPRI coset geometries for S_n of rank n-1. The specified group action is retained and set order/type labels may be renamed.
rows.assessment: Current implication checked; unchanged original statement/qualification reused from the distinct bound prior scientific review. No excluded row promoted.

rows.target: For n >= 7 every source coset geometry of S_n of rank n-1 is RWPRI, without an initial RWPRI hypothesis.

rows.target: The largest normal subgroup of G contained in B is core_G(B)=intersection_i core_G(H_i); quotienting yields the faithful coset action, and for firm RWPRI geometries this kernel contains Phi(G).
